notes:
POC focused on Dedicated capacity and measurable SLOs. Customer is a healthcare SaaS vendor; data residency + audit trail are non-negotiable.

Key ask: proof that Redwood Dedicated can meet throughput guarantees for conversational triage and clinical summarization workloads while preserving low p95 latency. They want a realistic load profile, not synthetic bursts.

Performance targets (customer): p95 latency <= 120ms for short chat (<=128 tokens), sustainable throughput 120-180 req/s with 200 concurrent sessions for average prompt mix, embedding batch throughput of 600 embeds/min. Cost sensitivity: wants cost per 1M tokens to be within 30% of current baseline.

POC plan (agreed):
- Baseline: run current model (open variant) on 2-node Dedicated pool, single-GPU per replica, measure cold/hot cache behavior.
- Load tests: ramp to 200 concurrent, hold 30m step durations, collect p50/p95/p99, GPU% utilization, memory/GPU temp, KV cache hit rates.
- Soak test: 8-hour run at target throughput to surface degradation, OOMs, GC-like pauses.
- Representative prompts: anonymized clinical triage prompts, long discharge summaries for summarization, reranking sets of ~30 documents.
- Fallback policy test: force one replica down, validate automatic routing to warm spare; measure failover latency and token delta.
- Quantization/plan: evaluate int8 and 4-bit profiles for cost/latency trade-offs.

Infrastructure ask: recommend reserved GPU plan (initial request: 4x H100-equivalent or 8x A100-class GPUs), autoscale headroom for 25% burst, private VPC peering for secure egress. They want clear guidance on how reserved slots map to expected req/s at different seq-lens.

SLA discussion notes: Magnolia wants 99.95% availability, credits for >5min downtime, and a 30-day rollback window for model rollouts. Legal flagged data residency language (needs EU/US partitioning for EU customers).

Quotable from call: "We care less about peak spikes than steady-state predictability — predictable tail latencies and accounting matter."

Main risks: procurement timeline (budget locked in Apr), legal redlines on residency, and on-prem network topology for private deployment will add setup time.
